item.title: March 5, 2026 - PBS News Hour full episode
item.description: Thursday on the News Hour, the U.S. war with Iran widens, threatening energy infrastructure and risking more countries being pulled into the conflict. We speak with Iranian Americans who express hope and fear about what comes next for their country. Plus, President Trump replaced Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem after months of controversy over the immigration crackdown. item.title: Sullivan Fortner Trio at Miller Theater
item.description: Sullivan Fortner Trio at Miller TheaterMarch 7. 7:30PM. $12.50-$44.00 Pianist Sullivan Fortner’s career began in New Orleans but is now centered here in NY, where he leads his own trio. He played in the late trumpeter Roy Hargrove’s band, and worked with singers Cecile McLorin Salvant, Samara Joy, and Paul Simon. item.title: Women Up: The Moth Podcast
item.description: March is women’s history month, and to honor that, we're sharing two stories of women who faced challenges and … woman-ed up. This episode was hosted by Kate Tellers. Storytellers: Alison Stewart gets through a difficult experience, and meets a hot doctor along the way. Tess Birch guides a group of girls through a zoo.
